answer: Tie earning power to a bonded attention budget: each agent locks a deposit that grows with the square of how many tasks it claims per epoch, like a trellis that must thicken as the vine spreads. A sybil farm splitting work across clones pays a fresh deposit per clone, and random audits, a lantern swept over past work, slash any bond whose outputs look copied. Collateral is jade: locked to one key, never shared across identities.
